title: Chapter 212 Anna'S Clone
content:
Chapter 212 Anna'S Clone

After Ye Xueer left, Wang Shuo murmured "Sky City" several times.

The system prompt sounded again.

[After thousands of years of torture, the remnant soul of the Black Dragon King has been completely blackened. Justice died and evil sprouted. The weak remnant soul of the Black Dragon King has escaped. From then on, the dragon returned to the sea and the tiger roared in the mountains. ]

[You triggered a large-scale plot-the ancient undead army of Black Dragon City has revived. Because the remnant soul of the Black Dragon King is so weak, it will take a month to recover its strength and summon the undead army. After a month, darkness will sweep the earth! ]

Wang Shuo was shocked when he saw this prompt. It seemed that he had poked a huge hole!

[System Announcement: A player has triggered a large-scale plot event-the ancient undead army of Black Dragon City has revived. The Black Dragon King will gather all the undead in the ancient battlefield. The ambitious Black Dragon King will lead his undead army to make a comeback and vow to restore their former glory. ]

...

It was reported three times in a row!

The red system announcement prompt was forced to recall in everyone's mind.

In the Dahuai area, in each [chat channel], the blood-red system announcement was pinned to the top, and each large character seemed to be written in blood, which was shocking.

Northeast Tiger: "What's the situation? What's the situation?... Isn't it good to develop peacefully? You have to play so excitingly!"

Little Gray: "This reminds me of the incident of wild beasts surrounding the village, but the system announcement at that time was not so terrible!"

"Who is it, and do you think our life is not difficult enough?"

"Little Skeleton, don't be afraid, I have seen it in the ancient battlefield, it is completely vulnerable!"

"I am the Lord of Tiancun, Yoshida Mundo, everyone should learn from the last lesson, welcome everyone to develop together..."

"I am the secretary of the Tianba Village Youth League, welcome everyone to seek common development, brothers, come together..."

Zhao Shanhe: "Mountain and Sea Alliance..."

...

As they chatted, these guys started to advertise.

Wang Shuo also wanted to fight, but reality did not allow him to do so!

At this moment, a monster suddenly appeared in the altar.

The reason why she is called a monster is that although she is in human form, she has eight spider-like tentacles extending from her back, all in the form of white bones.

The dry long hair on her head is messy, and her face looks ferocious.

Hidden boss?

Wang Shuo checked the attributes and took a breath.

[Anna's clone, golden boss]

[Level: Level 40]

[Attack power: 800]

[Defense power: 400]

[Health value: 30000]

[Skills: spider silk entanglement, sharp bone spear, broken limb regeneration, terrifying howl. ]

[Note: Anna Truni, at level 40, split a clone to take care of the Black Dragon King. ]

Three highs, plus four skills.

Quite tricky.

Compared with Toad Brunei, the defense and health are the same, but the attack power is 98 points less.

But Toad Brunei is not a normal golden boss.

It can be said that this boss left a huge psychological shadow on Wang Shuo.

"Did you let the remnant soul of the Black Dragon King go?" Anna's clone asked sternly.

Wang Shuo frowned and silently retreated behind Gong Zheng.

There was no way, Wang Shuo couldn't bear it for a few more times.

After a series of battles, Gong Zheng's level has reached level 28.

Wang Shuo looked at Gong Zheng's main attributes.

[Level: Level 28]

[Strength: 52]

[Constitution: 240]

[Agility: 26]

[Energy: 25]

[Defense: 230]

[Command Value: 22]

[Life Value: 5200]

[Skill: "Vajra Sutra" (Level 2)]

[Skills: 1. Block, 2. Petrification 3. Damage Rebound, 4. Life Feedback, 5. Taishan Pressure. ]

Damage rebound and life feedback are skills attached to the skills.

After the skill is activated, you can get 80% damage rebound and 1% life recovery from the injury.

It's just that the mental power consumption is relatively large.

The petrification skill can increase health by 1,000.

"Prepare for attack!" Wang Shuo shouted.

The crossbow battalion lined up 10 bronze crossbow carts.
